items.a: Yes. All Invita IV protocols are Liquivida® USA formulas developed by board-certified emergency physicians and pharmacists. Every treatment is administered by trained medical professionals, and a safety consultation before treatment ensures we select the right protocol for you.

items.q: How long does a session take?
items.a: A typical IV drip session takes 30–60 minutes. NAD+ protocols run about 90 minutes. This follows a short 15-minute medical consultation where we review your health history and goals.

items.q: I already take vitamins — why IV?
items.a: When vitamins are taken orally, the gastrointestinal tract limits absorption — often just 10–30%. IV therapy delivers nutrients directly into the bloodstream at 100% absorption. If you want to actually feel the difference, IV is the superior method.

items.q: How often should I come in?
items.a: Your Invita medical professional will recommend a personalised schedule based on your consultation. Some clients benefit from weekly sessions; others come monthly for maintenance.

Yes — benefits are fast and tangible because nutrients bypass the digestive system and enter your bloodstream immediately. Reported results include more energy and mental clarity, stronger immunity, faster athletic recovery, better sleep, improved mood, healthier skin, and jet-lag or hangover relief.

Most healthy adults are eligible. Our pre-treatment consultation follows medical eligibility criteria to ensure the therapy is appropriate and safe for each individual. Invita’s treatments optimise wellness — they do not treat or diagnose medical conditions.

items.q: What should I expect when I arrive?
items.a: You’ll be welcomed by our team, offered refreshments, and settled into a comfortable private space. A medical professional will be with you throughout your session and available for questions before, during, and after.
